beginner_intro: Al-'Asr ("The Declining Day") is a Meccan surah of 3 ayahs. Arabic text: Al-Quran Hafazan System (Uthmani Hafs script). Translation: Pickthall (public domain).

translations.text: Lo! man is a state of loss,

ayahs.arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ

translations.text: Save those who believe and do good works, and exhort one another to truth and exhort one another to endurance.
